changelog.note: Added generic lifecycle metadata, immutable file-version history, protected historical downloads, document auditing, lifecycle search/filters and expanded diagnostics. Joomla 6 only.
Added optional Notifications and Tasks public-service bridges plus an ACL-protected Analytics provider.
Fixed mandatory Core package preflight on real Joomla installations.
Core integration migrated to canonical xdecaro\Core APIs with mandatory Core by xdecaro 1.3.0+; Joomla identifiers, database schema and document behavior remain unchanged.
First stable Documents by xdecaro release with secure private storage, administrator CRUD, Core UI integration and cross-product relation storage.
